_comment: Contract data, not code: shipped in the wheel and extended through STAPEL_SEARCH['DICTIONARIES']. `equivalents` are symmetric groups (any member expands to the whole group) — the only form both shipped engines understand natively. `rewrites` normalize the QUERY only, never the index. `stopwords` are removed from the query only: a corpus indexed without them can only be repaired by reindexing everything.
